description: Install Kunpeng DevKit in WebUI mode on Huawei Cloud. Create a Kunpeng (aarch64) ECS via Python SDK with random password, encrypt password via Python KMS SDK, use hcloud CLI for EIP/VPC operations, use Python paramiko SSH (password in process memory only) to install DevKit-All-x.x.x-Linux-Kunpeng.tar.gz, including framework and all plugins (porting/affinity/devtools/debugger/sys_perf/java_perf/sys_diagnosis). Use this skill when the user wants to: (1) install DevKit on a new Kunpeng ECS, (2) install DevKit on an existing Kunpeng ECS. Trigger: user mentions "DevKit", "Kunpeng DevKit", "install DevKit", "DevKit WebUI", "Kunpeng DevKit", "DevKit-All", "鲲鹏DevKit", "安装DevKit", "鲲鹏开发套件"
